simple.meaning: שִׂיחַ (sîyach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a contemplation ; by implication, an utterance.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 14 times across 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, Job, Psalms, and 1 more, beginning at 1 Samuel 1:16. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׂיחַ (H7879).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שִׂיחַ (sîyach) / H7879 is traced through 1 Samuel 1:16, 1 Kings 18:27, 2 Kings 9:11, Job 7:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H7879. siach שִׂיחַ noun masculine Psa 104:34 complaint, musing ; — absolute ׳שׂ 1Kin 18:27 Prov 23:29 ; suffix שִׂיחִי 1Sam 1:16 +, שִׂחִי Job 23:2 , שִׂיחוֺ 2Kin 9:11 ; Psa 102:1 ; — 1 plaint, complaint: Job 7:13 ; 9:27 ; 10:1 (|| נפשׁ מר ), 21:4 ; 23:2 ; Prov 23:29 ; Psa 55:3 (|| אָהִימָה ); בְּשִׁיחי קוֺלִי 64:2 ; שׂ ׳שָׁפַךְ י ׳לפני 102:1 ; 142:3 . following are dubious: 2 musing , 1Kin 18:27 (E) of a god, || לוֺ שִׂיג , (so RV; SS 'nachdenken' ; Buhl 'beschäftigt sein' ; AV talk ); Psa 104:34 of man (Buhl SS. Bae 'Rede , oder Gesang' ). — See also [ שֵׂחַ ] below 3 anxiety, trouble: שִׂיחִי מֵרֹב 1Sam 1:16 (defined in ᵑ0 by כַּעַס , compare HPS; so Buhl SS, but perhaps = 1 ). 4 talk: שִׂיחוֺ 2Kin 9:11 (so RV SS, but meaning obscurein context).
